title: Signal: pyproject declares no supported Python range
scope: A pyproject.toml file that declares a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range.
limitations: It matches a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pyproject.toml that mentions a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
